subtitle: NeoForge 1.21.1 - 5 subpacks
currentTask: Fix: water reflection painted on land instead of on water

tasks.title: Find why the water mask covered the whole screen
tasks.note: RenderTarget.bindWrite() does NOT clear; a TextureTarget clears to WHITE by default

tasks.title: Clear the mask target to black + copy the scene depth
Keep the mask pass on our own target in Fabulous mode
Live test in game
tasks.note: User to confirm: reflection on water only, none on land

notes: Root cause: maskTarget was never cleared, so it kept its initial WHITE clear colour and every pixel read as water
Second cause: the mask depth was stale, so hidden water behind terrain was still marked as water
Third cause: in Fabulous mode the translucent render type binds the game's own translucent target, stealing the mask pass
